title: When AI Meets Art

reader_summary.headline: On June 27th, our team headed to New York City.
reader_summary.overview: On June 27th, our team headed to New York City. We are at the A16Z office for the first-ever AI artist retreat. That was A16Z consumer partner, Justine Moore. Justine was one of many partners who attended this retreat, which brought together the builders behind some of the most popular AI creative tools in existence.

thesis: The podcast describes an event where A16Z partners, AI founders, and artists gathered to discuss how new tools are unbounding creativity and increasing the amount of art produced. The speakers argue that while prior technologies like drum machines increased the total volume of music by enabling both traditional and new methods, AI represents a shift toward intentionally imprecise, left-brain products that allow anyone with taste to create.
